title: Crispi Mustard-Dill Potato Fans
description: Hasselback potatoes sized for two and finished just before serving.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.text: Cut the potatoes crosswise in thin slits, stopping before the base. Use {potato}.

steps.title: Prepare the center
steps.text: Simmer the fans 12–15 minutes until barely tender, then drain thoroughly.

steps.title: Mix the finish
steps.text: Whisk {butter}, {dill}, {mustard} in a small pan over low heat until smooth. Add a spoonful of warm water if needed.

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.text: Brush with {oil}. Place in one layer on the crisper plate in the 4-qt glass container. Fit the adapter and PowerPod and select Air Fry. Cook 17–23 minutes in the Crispi until soft inside and lightly browned on top.

steps.title: Dress while warm
steps.text: Brush between the layers with the prepared mixture and serve straight away.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the topping a day ahead. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze cooled portions in a single layer for up to 1 month. Fridge reheat: warm covered to 165°F; add the topping last. Freezer reheat: thaw in the fridge before warming covered. Use unsalted plant butter or dairy-free cheese where needed. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 187 kcal, 3.3 g protein, 27.0 g total carbohydrate, 7.8 g fat, 2.0 g fiber, 9 mg sodium.
